comingLast.roast: hide his keys, hide his phone, keep him at the bar
needs 6 from 4 - his playing group has started the commentary
7 from his last 5 - grandstand finish at the wrong end
8 points buys freedom - Hope is pricing it higher by the minute
Hope needs him to stay exactly this bad for 6 more holes
4 holes between him and a very memorable presso
on 16 - every one of his remaining 6 holes is now appointment viewing
6 holes left to avoid the double blue - 5 points does it
at 1.4 a hole he is on track for the full ceremony
on 20 with 3 to go - the blue balls can smell the clubhouse
